title: Offline re-render — simulate once, render many
desc: Turns one recorded episode into several training clips with different lighting and textures, without re-running physics. Render-side changes only — moving objects, the robot, or its actions needs a real re-simulation.
metrics: replay fidelity: TCP stays within 0.8 mm (mean) / 9.5 mm (max) of the recording over 262 steps · outcome preserved (recorded True → replay True) · 3 visual draws

media.label: one episode, four looks — same motion, synced
